Description: Life sciences reagent supplier that also catalogs and distributes cell lines, including engineered and disease-model lines.
Biotech vendor offering cell lines, antibodies, and related reagents for research use.
Commercial supplier of cell lines, media, and reagents for cell biology research.
Curated, publicly available collection of genome-edited human iPSC lines with endogenously tagged proteins, maintained by the Allen Institute.
One of the largest and most established global biological resource centers, providing authenticated cell lines, microorganisms, and other biomaterials.
Commercial vendor supplying cell lines, plasmids, and reagents for molecular and cell biology.
Biotech company specializing in genome editing services and engineered stem cell lines (including CRISPR knock-in/knock-out iPSC lines).
Supplier of human iPSC-derived cells (neurons, cardiomyocytes, etc.) for disease modeling and drug discovery.

Attribute: Banco de Células do Rio de Janeiro (BCRJ)
Description: Brazilian cell bank providing authenticated human and animal cell lines to the research community.

Attribute: Biodefense and Emerging Infections Research Resources Repository (BEI Resources)
Description: NIAID-established, ATCC-operated repository providing pathogens, reagents, and related biomaterials for infectious disease research.
Taiwanese national biobank maintaining and distributing cell lines and microbial strains.
Repository specializing in cancer research reagents, including cell lines, antibodies, and plasmids.
Commercial supplier of cell-based assay kits, reagents, and cell lines for biomedical research.
German-based commercial cell bank offering authenticated human and animal cell lines.
National Australian biobank providing authenticated cell lines for research use.
Boston University/Boston Medical Center iPSC core and repository, distributing control and disease-specific iPSC lines including gene-edited lines.

Attribute: Collection of Cell Lines in Veterinary Medicine (CCLV)
Description: German biobank (Friedrich-Loeffler-Institute) specializing in veterinary and farm-animal cell lines.
US-based nonprofit biorepository distributing cell lines, DNA, and biospecimens for a wide range of genetic and disease research, including many NIA/NIGMS-funded collections.

Attribute: Deutsche Sammlung von Mikroorganismen und Zellkulturen (DSMZ)
Description: German national biological resource center providing authenticated human, animal, and microbial cell lines.
NIH-supported repository distributing hybridoma cell lines and monoclonal antibodies for developmental biology research.
Commercial vendor (now part of Eurofins) providing engineered cell lines and assay technologies.
NIH-funded repository providing Drosophila cell lines, plasmids, and genomic resources.

Attribute: European Bank for induced pluripotent Stem Cells (EBiSC)
Description: European consortium biobank distributing quality-controlled, disease-relevant human iPSC lines.

Attribute: European Collection of Authenticated Cell Cultures (ECACC)
Description: UK-based cell bank (part of Culture Collections) providing authenticated human and animal cell lines.
Austrian biotech providing immortalized human cell lines for research and biomanufacturing.
Commercial biobank and manufacturer of iPSC-derived cell products, including the CIRM iPSC bank distribution.
Commercial supplier of genomic reagents, including cell lines, clones, and vectors.
Global biotech supplier offering custom cell line engineering and stable cell line products alongside its broader reagent catalog.
Commercial vendor (part of Revvity) specializing in genome-edited cell lines and gene editing technologies.
NIMH intramural program that collects and distributes postmortem human brain tissue for psychiatric and neurological research.

Attribute: Human Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells Initiative (HipSci)
Description: UK-based large-scale iPSC resource generating and distributing genotyped, phenotyped human iPSC lines.
Commercial life sciences vendor offering cell lines and related biological products.
Commercial supplier of engineered and reporter cell lines for oncology and virology research.
Spanish biotech company providing primary cells and cell lines for research use.
Italian cell bank (part of IRCCS San Martino) offering authenticated human and animal cell lines.
Commercial supplier of reporter and engineered cell lines alongside reagents for innate immunity and inflammation research.

Attribute: Istituto Zooprofilattico Sperimentale della Lombardia e dell'Emilia Romagna (IZSLER)
Description: Italian veterinary institute biobank providing animal cell cultures.

Attribute: Japanese Collection of Research Bioresources Cell Bank (JCRB)
Description: Japanese national cell bank distributing authenticated human and animal cell lines.
Biomedical research institution long known for mouse genetics and models, which also maintains its own JAX iPSC Repository, established prior to and independent of the 2025 NYSCF acquisition.

Combined research entity formed in 2025 through JAX's acquisition of NYSCF, operating from NYSCF's former Manhattan facility as part of JAX's network; use for cell lines registered or distributed under the joint entity going forward.
Commercial marketplace distributing unique reagents and cell lines sourced directly from academic labs.
South Korean national cell bank providing authenticated cell lines for research.

Attribute: Kunming Cell Bank of Type Culture Collection (KCB)
Description: Chinese cell bank (Kunming Institute of Zoology) maintaining and distributing cell lines.
Commercial biotech vendor supplying engineered and stable cell lines.
Global life sciences supplier offering a broad catalog of cell lines and reagents (part of MilliporeSigma/Merck KGaA).
Iranian national biobank (Pasteur Institute of Iran) maintaining and distributing cell lines.

Attribute: National Centralized Repository for Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias (NCRAD)
Description: NIA-funded national repository distributing biospecimens, cell lines, and genetic data for AD/ADRD research.

Nonprofit stem cell research foundation and biobank, historically operating independently; maintains the NYSCF Global Stem Cell Array, a large iPSC repository. As of 2025, NYSCF's operations were integrated into The Jackson Laboratory under The JAX-NYSCF Collaborative — this entry covers lines registered/cited under the NYSCF name prior to or independent of that integration.
NINDS-supported repository (Human Cell and Data Repository, NHCDR) distributing disease-relevant stem cell lines for neurological research.
Life sciences company (rebranded Revvity) offering cell lines and assay reagents for drug discovery and diagnostics.
Japanese national biobank distributing authenticated human and animal cell lines.
Commercial antibody and reagent supplier that also offers cell lines and lysates.

Attribute: Rutgers University Cell and DNA Repository (RUCDR)
Description: Rutgers-affiliated (also branded RUCDR Infinite Biologics) biorepository providing DNA, RNA, and cell line processing/distribution services for large-scale genetics studies.
Global life sciences supplier (part of MilliporeSigma) offering a broad cell line catalog for research use.
Sigma-Aldrich's role as a commercial distribution channel for EBiSC-banked iPSC lines.
Canadian biotech company supplying stem cells, primary cells, and reagents for cell biology research.
Japanese university-based cell line catalog (Institute of Development, Aging and Cancer).
Chinese biotech company offering CRISPR-engineered cell lines and gene editing services.
US-based nonprofit stem cell bank (originating from the WiCell Research Institute) distributing human embryonic and induced pluripotent stem cell lines.
UK-based reagent marketplace (part of LGC) distributing cell lines and antibodies sourced from academic research.
